review:
A western Megaways game with up to 117,649 ways, tumbling reels and dynamite multipliers worth up to 500x – in the base game and the bonus – which add together.

Four to six scatters give 15 to 25 free spins, where every multiplier on a winning spin joins a running total. Retriggers can add up to 30 more spins. Basically Gates of Olympus in a cowboy hat, on Megaways. Up to 5,000x, 96.55% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
